about.lead: I turn complex problems into rigorous software solutions — from mathematical modeling to a deployed product.
about.p1: I am a Computer Scientist trained at the Faculty of Mathematics & Computer Science (MATCOM), University of Havana, specialized in Data Science, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. Awarded the Scientific Merit Award for an outstanding research trajectory.
about.p2: As a Consultant Specialist at the Finlay Vaccine Institute (BioCubaFarma) I design AI-powered platforms —multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines and AutoML flows— and build web, mobile and desktop applications. I take products end to end: from mathematical and data modeling to polished, deployed software.
